$comment: Periodic worker cadences, reconnects, poll windows, and in-memory caps. Reviewed file, not a UI knob. Values preserve pre-extraction behavior.
_modelRuntimeMaxChildrenComment: 2026-10-08 defect A2: ModelRuntimeManager spawned Ollama/Chronos children into a push-only array with no cap and no reaping. Children are now tracked in a bounded set reaped on exit; spawns past this cap are refused (excess child SIGKILLed, not leaked). Production never needs more than 2 (ollama + chronos); 4 leaves headroom for a retry overlap.
_aiProviderQuarantineCooldownComment: 2026-10-08 defect A1: aiProviders.health='Offline' was a sticky quarantine - routeTask/routeConsensus exclude Offline providers whenever any live provider remains, and the only writer back to a routable health was a successful ROUTED call the exclusion made unreachable. After this cooldown elapses (measured from the row's last_failure), AIProviderHealthCheck's real periodic re-probe restores the provider to 'Degraded' on success; a failed re-probe keeps it Offline. 1h is deliberately longer than every router-side skip cooldown (auth 5min, timeout 1min, quota/model 30min in tradingSafety.json) so recovery probes never run hotter than routing's own backoffs.
_candidateRankingsRetentionBatchComment: 2026-10-01 defect verification pass: sweepCandidateRankingsRetention() previously ran one single unbatched DELETE, same class of defect as observability_events's sweep (see config/observability.json's own comment for the first live reproduction). Live-reproduced a second time against this table: with trading freshly enabled and real ranking cycles running, the engine's event loop (including /health) went unresponsive again shortly after boot, CPU pegged near 100% continuously - this file's own 2026-09-22 comment already documented the table had grown to 1.38M+ rows with no retention at all before that date, so a real backlog beyond the 14-day cutoff was plausible. Same batching + yielding fix as ObservabilityStore.ts.
_newsRetentionComment: 2026-10-08 memory-leak follow-up: news_articles and news_clusters grew on disk with no prune path anywhere in the codebase (the same defect class as candidate_rankings on 2026-09-22). news_articles rows are bulky (content/summary text) and lose trading value fast - the RiskEngine news veto only reads clusters from the last 4h and catalysts expire intraday - so 30 days is generous. news_clusters are the durable news record of truth (PredictionOutcomeEvaluator links news_predictions to cluster ids) and are small metadata rows, so they get a longer 90-day window. Both sweeps are batched + yielding like sweepCandidateRankingsRetention so a large backlog can never block the event loop.
_newsAdjacentRetentionComment: 2026-10-08 defect hunt (news D2 / infra P2-R1/P2-R3): four more append-only tables with no prune path. escalation_decisions (one row per analyzed article) and staged_news_catalysts terminal rows (CONSUMED/EXPIRED; the live queue is size-pruned separately in NewsCatalystStore) lose value within days. jev_shadow_scores and ai_calls (bulky prompt/response text; all ai_calls readers are windowed) get 30 days. news_predictions aligns to news_clusters (90d) since predictions reference cluster ids.
_sessionGuardRetentionComment: 2026-10-08 synthetic session guard (SynthesisDefectSweep follow-up): a 6-minute synthetic session wrote rows to 8 tables with no retention path anywhere in the codebase - the same defect class as news_articles. Retentions are conservative: ohlcv_bars keeps a full year for backtests/audits; predictions are graded within hours (evaluationHorizonMs=1h) so 30d is generous; ledgers/traces keep 90d.
_decisionProvenanceRetentionComment: 2026-10-09 (certification mission item 1 - OCT9_PIT_PROVENANCE_ESCAPE): per-Quant-decision PIT replay provenance. 90 days, aligned with pitDecisionLedgerRetentionDays - both are decision-audit records; the provenance row is what lets a past decision be replayed identically from retained inputs.
_consensusRetentionComment: 2026-10-10 defect hunt (Track 1, soak-path retention): a 180-sim-minute SOAK_3H synthetic session wrote rows to consensus_debate_predictions (27), consensus_decisions (8), consensus_evidence (10) and reconciliation_events (1) with no prune path anywhere in the codebase - the same defect class as candidate_rankings/news_articles. Decision-audit records, 90d aligned with pitDecisionLedger/decisionProvenance; consensus_evidence is pruned via its parent consensus_decisions row.
_soakPathRetention2Comment: 2026-10-10 defect hunt (Track 1, part 2): twelve more append-only session-path tables with no prune path. Fast-decaying artifacts (ai_usage, kronos_predictions, quant_forecasts) 30d; audit/learning records 90d. risk_gate_results deliberately NOT swept: per-gate detail of risk_assessments (permanent decision record).
